source_csv.units_basis: CSV column names Q_min_m3s and Q_max_m3s
source_csv.release_semantics: total reservoir release (user-declared), not turbine-only flow
source_csv.derivation: user reports historical inflows and admissible storage envelopes; generator not supplied
source_csv.information_limitation: historical realized daily inflows may not be known before dispatch; causal/forecast availability and use of future data cannot be verified without the construction algorithm
source_csv.provenance_status: supplied CSV; derivation and operational semantics not independently verified

policy_status: fresh default networks, frozen at initialization; no training or learned-performance claim
comparison: identical initial state and fixed weights across A/B/C; policies observe their own evolving environment state
penalty_scope: existing Eq.16 valid inside-proposal inverse only; scaled/outside corrections are descriptive

A.aggregation: pooled executed-day counts and summed energy; partial coverage explicitly labelled

proposal_quality.rate_definition: genuine corrections with abs(u_original-u_realized)>tau / valid controllable reservoir-days; threshold roundoff excluded
proposal_quality.denominator_exclusions: physical forced dispatch, degenerate proposal, invalid/outside-interval inverse, unobserved legacy rows; infeasible attempts counted separately
proposal_quality.physical_intervention_definition: genuine physical release changes / physical nonforced reservoir-days; includes degenerate-proposal repairs
proposal_quality.forced_dispatch_definition: physically degenerate feasible interval; frequency denominator is all observed executed reservoir-days
proposal_quality.scaled_release_correction_definition: abs(executed-target)/proposal_width for nondegenerate proposals; descriptive only; mean over all valid-width rows including zero changes and physical forced dispatch
proposal_quality.magnitude_scope: discharge mean/max/sum over genuine events; normalized mean/max/sum over genuine valid-inverse events; all_release_difference statistics also retain forced/numerical differences
proposal_quality.infeasibility_definition: failed execution attempts; an unknown station failure is not duplicated across five reservoirs
